entries.question: How can I get admission in kgmu
entries.answer:

You can find detailed information regarding admissions for various courses here: [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php)

In general:
*   **MBBS/BDS:** Admission is based on the **NEET-UG** examination conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA), followed by the centralized counseling process.
*   **Postgraduate (MD/MS/MDS):** Admission is based on **NEET-PG** or **NEET-MDS** scores through centralized counseling.
*   **Super Specialty (DM/MCh):** Admission is based on **NEET-SS** scores.
*   **Nursing and Paramedical:** KGMU typically conducts its own entrance examinations or participates in state-level entrance tests for these programs.

I recommend visiting the official [Courses & Admission page](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) to check the specific eligibility criteria, entrance exam requirements, and application procedures for the course you are interested in.

Main salah dunga ki aap admission ke liye [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) par jaakar course-specific brochure aur latest guidelines zarur padhein.
